page: Microsoft Azure ND96isr_H100_v5 is an isolated, RDMA-capable virtual machine belonging to the NDSH100v5 server family. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor with 96 dedicated vCPUs, this instance is designed for high-end parallel computing workloads. It features 1900.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 19.79 GB of RAM per core, and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

For acceleration and storage, the server is equipped with 8.0 GPUs and a massive 31769 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is Premium Storage capable and supports RDMA networking, which facilitates low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

From a qualitative perspective, this instance represents a premium, high-density hardware class designed for massive resource allocation rather than budget-oriented general computing. The combination of high-capacity local NVMe storage, extensive system memory, and eight GPUs makes it suitable for large-scale deep learning, heavy database workloads, complex scientific simulations, and distributed high-performance computing tasks.
